name: JoAi: List Client Proposals

title.it: Visualizza le proposte per i clienti

description.en: View the team's tailored client proposals, including their status, selected scope, validity, and resulting quote when a client has confirmed.
description.de: Zeige die individuellen Kundenangebote des Teams mit Status, gewähltem Umfang, Gültigkeit und dem entstandenen verbindlichen Angebot nach Bestätigung an.
description.es: Consulta las propuestas personalizadas del equipo, con estado, alcance seleccionado, vigencia y la cotización resultante tras la confirmación.
description.fr: Affichez les propositions clients personnalisées de l’équipe, avec leur statut, périmètre sélectionné, validité et devis créé après confirmation.
description.it: Visualizza le proposte personalizzate del team, con stato, ambito selezionato, validità e preventivo creato dopo la conferma.
description.ro: Afișează ofertele personalizate ale echipei, inclusiv statusul, pachetul selectat, valabilitatea și oferta formală creată după confirmare.

bot: Use this to review proposal follow-up after a discovery call or to check whether a client has confirmed. Do not create or send a formal quote yourself: a quote is created only when the client confirms their selection on the shared proposal page.
